title: Jurisdiction Pack
description: Schema for jurisdiction-scoped regulatory intelligence packaging used by reviewed artifacts and future downstream consumers.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this jurisdiction_pack payload.

jurisdiction_pack_id.description: Stable identifier for this jurisdiction pack.

pack_name.description: Human-readable name for this jurisdiction pack.

country_scope.description: Country or regional codes explicitly covered by this jurisdiction pack.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Human-readable jurisdictions explicitly covered by this pack.

legal_system_scope.description: Legal system scope represented by this jurisdiction pack.

nomenclature_scope.description: Nomenclature or tariff schedule scope covered by this pack.

regulatory_source_families.description: Regulatory source families explicitly included in this jurisdiction pack.

source_refs.description: Explicit local or reviewed source references supporting this jurisdiction pack. Raw source bodies and production URLs are not embedded.

review_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the associated review_manifest identifier.

effective_from.description: Date when this jurisdiction pack becomes effective.

status.description: Review and lifecycle status for this jurisdiction pack.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions that constrain safe use of this pack.

limitations.description: Known limitations for this jurisdiction pack.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether downstream consumption is allowed under the current review state.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this jurisdiction pack record was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this jurisdiction pack record was last updated.

pack_version.description: Optional semantic version for this jurisdiction pack.

region_scope.description: Optional regional scope labels for this pack.

valid_until.description: Optional UTC timestamp until this pack remains valid.

source_version_refs.description: Optional source_version identifiers backing this jurisdiction pack.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence artifact references supporting this pack.

affected_topics.description: Optional regulatory or operational topics covered by this pack.

supported_artifact_types.description: Optional artifact types this jurisdiction pack can support.

language.description: Optional primary language tag for this pack.

owner.description: Optional local owner or steward identifier.

reviewer_notes.description: Optional reviewer notes that preserve audit context.

uncertainty_notes.description: Optional uncertainty notes for downstream interpretation.

supersedes_pack_ref.description: Optional reference to a prior jurisdiction pack superseded by this one.
